task.name: grasp_knife_place_plate
task.description: Use the left arm to grasp the knife from the holder and place it on the plate.

substages.substage: 1. Move the left arm to approach and align with the knife holder.
2. Grasp the knife from the holder.
3. Move the left arm to align with the plate.
4. Release the gripper to place the knife on the plate.
